blocks.text: Match preview: Sri Lanka face India in 1st Test (TEST) on Sat, 15 Aug, 2026, 10:00 am at Galle International Stadium Galle. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Spin-friendly Sri Lankan tracks; deteriorate quickly on day 4–5 in Tests.
Drizzle · High 29°C / Low 25°C · Rain: 6 mm · Wind: up to 22 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
